name: Puva
title: Son of Issachar
summary: Puva (also spelled Pua) was the second son of Issachar, who was one of Jacob's twelve sons. He is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and Numbers as one of those who went down to Egypt with Jacob's family. His descendants became known as the clan of the Puvaite.

keyEvents.title: Born as the son of Issachar
keyEvents.description: Puva was born as the second son of Issachar, one of Jacob's twelve sons. He was part of the growing family that made up the patriarchs of Israel.

keyEvents.title: The Journey to Egypt
keyEvents.description: Puva was among Jacob's descendants who went down to Egypt during the famine, when Joseph was the ruler there. He was one of the 70 people from Jacob's household who settled in Goshen.

keyEvents.title: Listed among the sons of Issachar in the Books of Moses
keyEvents.description: In Numbers, Puvva is recorded as the founder of the clan of the Punites (Puvvites) in connection with the census in the wilderness.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Puvva (here called Pua) is mentioned in the genealogies in 1 Chronicles as one of Issachar's sons, confirming his place in Israel's tribal history.
